description: Defines the 'BulkLeaveEntitlementMatchingEmployeeModel' class, which models bulk leave entitlement data for multiple employees within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for employees and entitlements, constructor logic, and methods to serialize data into an array format.

classes.name: BulkLeaveEntitlementMatchingEmployeeModel
classes.description: A model representing bulk leave entitlement data for a set of employees, supporting serialization and validation within the HRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with employee data, entitlement data, and an optional entitlement amount (defaults to zero).

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the model data into an array format suitable for API responses, including employee details and entitlement calculations.
